claims.object_text: synaptic regulation in the cortex and basal ganglia
claims.quote: Through its interaction with the presynaptic plasma membrane protein SNAP25, the PRRT2 protein may play a role in synaptic regulation in the cortex and basal ganglia.
PRRT2 mutations likely have a loss-of-function effect and result in synaptic deregulation and neuronal hyperexcitability.
